topNews.excerpt: The elusive vaquita porpoise swims in the wild only in shallow northern waters of Mexico’s Gulf of California (also known as the Sea of Cortez)—and it’s one of the rarest and most endangered marine mammals on Earth. topNews.text: First Puffin Chick in 30 Years Spotted Emerging From Cliffs Along England’s South Coast
topNews.excerpt: Conservationists were holding their breaths this Spring as the last remaining colony of puffins was in danger of being lost altogether, but relief turned to joy as, not only did the adult puffins return, a baby was born. topNews.text: Scientists Identify Gene at the Center of Muscular Aging – And How Exercise Defeats it
